info.name: Unscheduled Removal Risk API
info.description:
FastAPI service from https://github.com/baoloc97/aircraft_mro.

Start it with `uvicorn api.main:app --reload` (needs data/raw/, see README), then run the collection. `base_url` defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8000 and `as_of_date` to 2025-10-15; dates must fall inside the mock data window 2024-02-01 to 2025-12-31. Each request has a saved example response (the same files as docs/sample_responses/) and tests.
